haiti.title: Flag of the Republic of Haiti

colors.note: Upper band; represents Haitians of African descent and solidarity with the continent.
Lower band; represents Haitians of mixed heritage and the blood shed for liberty.
Central rectangle bearing the coat of arms; represents peace.

desc:
- Two horizontal bands of blue and red with the national coat of arms on a white rectangle at the centre
- The coat of arms features a palm tree topped with the Phrygian cap of liberty, flanked by cannons and flags, above the motto L'Union Fait la Force
- The current version was restored on 17 February 1986 after the fall of the Duvalier regime, returning the original 1803 colours
trivia:
- According to tradition, the flag was created in May 1803 when Jean-Jacques Dessalines tore the white from the French tricolour, symbolically removing European rule
- The motto L'Union Fait la Force (Unity Makes Strength) commemorates the successful 1791 to 1804 slave revolt that produced the first independent Black republic
- Between 1964 and 1986 the Duvalier regime used a black and red flag; the original blue and red was restored after his son's fall from power
